A little Christmas escape · 2026

Christmas, without a checklist.

Five unhurried nights at Boar's Head Resort. One gorgeous place to stay, a little holiday magic, and plenty of permission to do absolutely nothing.

2 adults + 1 three-year-oldCharlottesville, Virginia~3-hour drive from Durham5 nights
Winter Wander · Boar's Head Resort
The idea

Not a trip full of things to do.
A beautiful place to be.

All three versions have the same delightfully loose plan: take mornings slowly, eat well, enjoy your room, and wander out for Christmas lights only when the mood strikes. The budget mostly changes the quality of the room, the dining, and how much convenience you buy.

Which five nights sound better?

Christmas is behind you; the lights and holiday atmosphere remain. Fewer holiday-day logistics, though New Year's Eve dining may require planning.

These choices change the experience notes, not the estimated costs. No dates or rooms have been held.

Our recommended version

Country Estate Retreat

The separate living space gives grown-ups somewhere comfortable to sit after toddler bedtime. That may be the most important upgrade of the entire trip.

  • Junior Suite King: king bedroom, separate sitting room, queen sleeper sofa, balcony or patio.
  • Leisurely breakfasts in the room and a few lovely Mill Room dinners.
  • Optional Kids' Den time, if age eligibility and holiday staffing are confirmed.

Junior Suite King is phone-reservation only; call 1-844-611-8066.

The biggest luxury isn't necessarily spa time. It's an actual separate room after bedtime, decent dining without logistics, and time for both adults to rest.

No itinerary required

Three things, at most.

One lovely meal

Book one festive dinner, ideally at the Mill Room. Let the other meals be casual, room service, or whatever sounds easy that day.

One enchanted evening

Winter Wander is right on the resort grounds. Package guests can come and go without a timed entry slot on operating nights. It's outdoors, so keep it optional.

Several gloriously blank days

Read, nap, enjoy the lobby, stroll, let a three-year-old rediscover the decorations, and avoid turning relaxation into another to-do list.

Just enough preparation

Book the essentials.
Leave the rest open.

  • Compare refundable room or suite quotes for your five-night dates.
  • Ask about the Winter Wander lodging package and how it compares to an ordinary room rate.
  • Reserve one holiday meal, especially if staying on Christmas Day or New Year's Eve.
  • If desired, confirm Kids' Den accepts a 3-year-old on those dates before relying on it.
See official stay packages ↗Call about suites

Worth knowing before booking

  1. Winter Wander: November 13, 2026–January 2, 2027, on select nights. Its nearly half-mile lake trail is mostly hard-surfaced, but outdoors. Unlimited, untimed entry applies specifically to the overnight Winter Wander package.
  2. Kids' Den: $35/hour for resort guests, up to 3 hours while parents remain on-property. Age eligibility and holiday availability are not yet confirmed. Ask childcare ↗
  3. Suites: Junior Suite King has a separate living room and queen sleeper sofa, but must be reserved by phone. Cottage No. 1 is more spacious, with a fireplace; its availability and price must be checked directly.
  4. Winter limitations: Outdoor family swimming is seasonal. Don't budget a swim-centered trip. The spa closes Christmas Day.
  5. Pregnancy: The relaxing part is the suite and service; avoid counting on hot tubs, steam rooms or saunas. Any treatment should be pregnancy-appropriate.
